_comment: Hand-curated shared requirement routes, used by quests (later diaries/bosses) via "access": "<key>". A requirement is met when every card of any one route is owned; a route item that is a list = any one of those cards; a route with "spell" = that spell's full rune cost from spells.json (elemental runes also met by a staff / combination rune, rune_sources.json). Routes marked manual have no card to check (shown for information, never auto-met). Desert sources: OSRS Wiki Shantay Pass, Fairy rings (BIQ/DLQ/AKP), Necklace of passage, Pharaoh's sceptre, Desert amulet, Kharidian Desert (Lumbridge Swamp shortcut). Ranged lists: standard metal tiers from the card catalog. Area routes (morytania, kourend, varlamore, …) researched from the wiki 2026-10-09; a route may also require quests, skills, or other areas ("areas": [key]).

routes.label: Shantay Pass (buy a pass from Shantay for 5 coins)
Fairy ring BIQ / DLQ / AKP (Fairytale I done, Fairytale II started)
Pharaoh's sceptre teleport (pyramids)
Desert amulet 2+ teleport (Nardah)
Necklace of passage → Eagles' Eyrie (Jade necklace card)
Desert Elite diary done — free passage through the Shantay Pass
Lumbridge Swamp shortcut — Agility 66 + Lumbridge & Draynor hard diary
Nardah / Pollnivneach teleport scroll, or Camulet (no card)
Bow + arrows
Crossbow + bolts
Darts
Throwing knives
Thrownaxes
Other combat spells need these runes plus more — the Wind spell is the cheapest of each tier
Walk east through Paterdomus Temple (Priest in Peril complete)
routes.wiki: Morytania: "Players must complete the Priest in Peril quest to enter."

routes.label: Fairy ring CKS (Canifis) / ALQ (Haunted Woods) / BKR (Mort Myre)
routes.wiki: Fairy ring: "cks ... after completion of Priest in Peril"; rings need a dramen or lunar staff.

routes.label: Kharyrll Teleport (Ancient spellbook, Magic 66) to Canifis
routes.wiki: Morytania transport table: Kharyrll Teleport — Canifis — Desert Treasure I.

routes.label: Ectophial to Port Phasmatys (no card)
routes.wiki: Morytania transport table: Ectophial — Port Phasmatys — Ghosts Ahoy.

routes.label: Charter ship to Port Phasmatys (pay coins; Trader crewmember has no card)
routes.wiki: Charter ship: "Port Phasmatys, desc: Requires Priest in Peril".

routes.label: Slayer ring teleport to the Slayer Tower
routes.wiki: Morytania transport table: Slayer ring — Slayer Tower, Mort Ridge mines.

routes.label: Salve Graveyard / Barrows / Fenkenstrain's castle teleport tablets (no card; need Drezel's warning)
routes.wiki: Morytania transport table: "Priest in Peril, heard Drezel's warning".

routes.label: Veos's ship at Port Sarim to Port Piscarilius or Land's End (free)
routes.wiki: Great Kourend: "Players can travel to Great Kourend by speaking to Veos by his ship ... in Port Sarim".

routes.label: Fairy rings, charter ships, Sailing docks, games/skills necklaces — all need a first visit (via Veos) before they work
routes.wiki: Fairy ring CIS: "The player must have visited Great Kourend at least once"; charter Port Piscarilius/Land's End: "Requires visiting Great Kourend".

routes.label: Regulus Cento's quetzal outside Varrock east gate (Children of the Sun complete; Regulus has no card)
routes.wiki: Varlamore: "all require the player to first travel via Regulus Cento ... after completing Children of the Sun before other transportation methods become usable."

routes.label: Barge from the Digsite (talk to the barge guard; no card)
routes.wiki: Fossil Island: "In order to reach the island, players must have completed the Bone Voyage quest." ... "reached via the barge from the Digsite".

routes.label: Digsite pendant to the barge, then talk to the barge guard
routes.wiki: Fossil Island: "teleport the player near the barge at the Digsite, where they can fast travel to the Museum Camp by speaking to the barge guard."

routes.label: Daero (Grand Tree) → Waydar's glider → Lumdo's boat from Crash Island (none have cards)
routes.wiki: Ape Atoll: "Initial access ... requires the player to first travel via Lumdo on Crash Island during Monkey Madness I." (partial MM1 modelled as complete)

routes.label: Fairy ring CLR — needs Agility 48 + ninja/kruk greegree to leave the agility course
routes.wiki: Fairy ring CLR: "Requires completion of the Monkey Madness I quest. In addition, 48 Agility and a Ninja monkey greegree or Kruk monkey greegree are required".

routes.label: Ape Atoll Teleport (standard spellbook, Magic 64; needs a banana)
routes.wiki: Ape Atoll: "The level 64 Ape Atoll Teleport is available ... after Freeing King Awowogei"; cost Law 2, Fire 2, Water 2, Banana 1.

routes.label: Gnome glider to Ookookolly Undri (no card)
routes.wiki: Ape Atoll: "The Gnome glider network can take players to the north-west of the island after completion of Monkey Madness II".

routes.label: Walk over Arandar (or from Iorwerth camp) into the city
routes.wiki: Prifddinas: "All methods of entering the city require completion of Song of the Elves" ... "walk west over the mountain pass of Arandar".

routes.label: Necklace of passage → Jorral's outpost, then Arandar (Jade necklace card)
routes.wiki: Prifddinas: "Necklace of passage to Jorral's outpost and then walk west over the mountain pass of Arandar".

routes.label: Charter ship to Prifddinas
routes.wiki: Charter ship: "Prifddinas, desc: Requires Song of the Elves".

routes.label: Eternal teleport crystal
routes.wiki: Prifddinas: "Teleport crystal or eternal teleport crystal to get to the centre of Prifddinas".

routes.label: Sailing 70 to the west mooring point (needs adamant keel+; boat not checkable)
routes.wiki: Prifddinas: "At 70 Sailing, docking at the mooring point west of the city (requires an adamant keel or better)".

tirannwn.label: Tirannwn access (Isafdar / Lletya area)
tirannwn.notes: Lletya itself also needs Mourning's End Part I started (Eluned, who has a card, brings you the first time).

routes.label: Arandar mountain pass (Regicide complete)
routes.wiki: Tirannwn: "All of the following require completion of the Regicide quest: ... Travelling through Arandar".

routes.label: Necklace of passage → Outpost, then Arandar (Jade necklace card)
routes.wiki: Lletya: "Necklace of passage to the Outpost, passing Arandar, and navigating the forest."

routes.label: Charter ship to Port Tyras
routes.wiki: Tirannwn: "Boarding a charter ship to Port Tyras" (requires Regicide).

routes.label: Fairy ring BJS (Zul-Andra island) — Agility 76 to jump off
routes.wiki: Fairy ring BJS: "Requires completion of the Regicide quest. 76 Agility is needed to jump off the island."

routes.label: Underground Pass after starting Regicide (planner can't check a started quest)
routes.wiki: Tirannwn: "It can initially only be accessed via the Underground Pass after starting Regicide."

mos_le_harmless.label: Mos Le'Harmless access
mos_le_harmless.notes: Talking to the islanders needs the Book o' piracy (no card) in the inventory.

routes.label: Bill Teach's boat at Port Phasmatys (no card)
routes.wiki: Mos Le'Harmless: "You must complete Cabin Fever to access the island. Talk to Bill Teach on the eastern boat in Port Phasmatys."

routes.label: Charter ship to Mos Le'Harmless
routes.wiki: Charter ship: "Mos Le'Harmless, desc: Requires Cabin Fever".

routes.label: Minigame Teleport to Trouble Brewing (Cooking 40)
routes.wiki: Mos Le'Harmless: "Use the Minigame Teleport to Trouble Brewing (requires completion of the quest and 40 Cooking)."

routes.label: Harmony Island → Brother Tranquility (no card)
routes.wiki: Mos Le'Harmless: "Teleport to Harmony Island and talk to Brother Tranquility."; Harmony Island Teleport needs The Great Brain Robbery.

routes.label: Jarvald's boat from Rellekka — 1,000 coins (Jarvald has no card)
routes.wiki: Jarvald: "If the player has not completed The Fremennik Trials quest, they must pay 1,000 coins per trip".

routes.label: Jarvald's boat free after The Fremennik Trials
routes.wiki: Jarvald: "after the quest, Jarvald will transport players for free."

routes.label: Waterbirth Teleport (Lunar spellbook, Magic 72)
routes.wiki: Waterbirth Island: "Cast Waterbirth Teleport (requires access to the Lunar spellbook and level 72 Magic)".

routes.label: Enchanted lyre — needs the Fremennik hard diary
routes.wiki: Waterbirth Island: "Use an enchanted lyre (with completion of the hard tier of the Fremennik Diary)".

routes.label: Waterbirth teleport tablet (no card), or Sailing 74 mooring point (boat not checkable)
routes.wiki: Waterbirth Island: "Use a Waterbirth teleport tablet"; "Through a mooring point with 74 Sailing."

routes.label: Magic carpet from Pollnivneach (pay the rug merchant; no card) — needs desert access

routes.label: Fairy ring AKP (Necropolis) — Agility 62, Beneath Cursed Sands

routes.label: Pharaoh's sceptre teleport to Jalsavrah (Pyramid Plunder)
routes.wiki: Sophanem: "Pharaoh's sceptre — Pyramid Plunder minigame (Jalsavrah)."

routes.wiki: Wilderness: "starting at level 1 at the Wilderness ditch" — no quest or item gate.

routes.label: Fairy ring BKS

routes.label: Abyss rift to the Cosmic Altar (in Zanaris) — Mage of Zamorak has no card

routes.wiki: Abyssal Nexus: "players who have partially completed Fairytale II - Cure a Queen can safely reach the Nexus using the code DIP".

routes.label: Sail there with your own boat (Sailing) — not tracked yet
Slayer helmet — as an ironman you craft it, so every component card is needed (Crafting 55 + the Malevolent masquerade unlock)
